$Comment: Names one lifetime tally for requirement lines: a player's Goblin Glutton kills (the ziggfreedcommon:counter reading under Mob_Kills/Goblin_Glutton). The Glutton contracts are locked until a player has beaten one, and without this name the lock would read as the generic requirements line; with it the board says what to do. To gate another contract on a different tally, ship a file like this one with that tally's Param and your own lang key.
